name: fsx
description: Amazon FSx is a fully managed service that makes it easy for storage and application administrators to launch and use shared file storage.

subcommands.name: associate-file-system-aliases
subcommands.description: Use this action to associate one or more Domain Name Server (DNS) aliases with an existing Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system.

subcommands.name: cancel-data-repository-task
subcommands.description: Cancels an existing Amazon FSx for Lustre data repository task if that task is in either the PENDING or EXECUTING state.

subcommands.name: copy-backup
subcommands.description: Copies an existing backup within the same Amazon Web Services account to another Amazon Web Services Region (cross-Region copy) or within the same Amazon Web Services Region (in-Region copy).

subcommands.name: copy-snapshot-and-update-volume
subcommands.description: Updates an existing volume by using a snapshot from another Amazon FSx for OpenZFS file system.

subcommands.name: create-and-attach-s3-access-point
subcommands.description: Creates an S3 access point and attaches it to an Amazon FSx volume.

subcommands.name: create-backup
subcommands.description: Creates a backup of an existing Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system, Amazon FSx for Lustre file system, Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP volume, or Amazon FSx for OpenZFS file system.

subcommands.name: create-data-repository-association
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon FSx for Lustre data repository association (DRA).

subcommands.name: create-data-repository-task
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon FSx for Lustre data repository task.

subcommands.name: create-file-cache
subcommands.description: Creates a new Amazon File Cache resource.

subcommands.name: create-file-system
subcommands.description: Creates a new, empty Amazon FSx file system.

subcommands.name: create-file-system-from-backup
subcommands.description: Creates a new Amazon FSx for Lustre, Amazon FSx for Windows File Server, or Amazon FSx for OpenZFS file system from an existing Amazon FSx backup.

subcommands.name: create-snapshot
subcommands.description: Creates a snapshot of an existing Amazon FSx for OpenZFS volume.

subcommands.name: create-storage-virtual-machine
subcommands.description: Creates a storage virtual machine (SVM) for an Amazon FSx for ONTAP file system.

subcommands.name: create-volume
subcommands.description: Creates an FSx for ONTAP or Amazon FSx for OpenZFS storage volume.

subcommands.name: create-volume-from-backup
subcommands.description: Creates a new Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP volume from an existing Amazon FSx volume backup.

subcommands.name: delete-backup
subcommands.description: Deletes an Amazon FSx backup.

subcommands.name: delete-data-repository-association
subcommands.description: Deletes a data repository association on an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system.

subcommands.name: delete-file-cache
subcommands.description: Deletes an Amazon File Cache resource.

subcommands.name: delete-file-system
subcommands.description: Deletes a file system.

subcommands.name: delete-snapshot
subcommands.description: Deletes an Amazon FSx for OpenZFS snapshot.

subcommands.name: delete-storage-virtual-machine
subcommands.description: Deletes an existing Amazon FSx for ONTAP storage virtual machine (SVM).

subcommands.name: delete-volume
subcommands.description: Deletes an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP or Amazon FSx for OpenZFS volume.

subcommands.name: describe-backups
subcommands.description: Returns the description of a specific Amazon FSx backup, if a BackupIds value is provided for that backup.

subcommands.name: describe-data-repository-associations
subcommands.description: Returns the description of specific Amazon FSx for Lustre or Amazon File Cache data repository associations, if one or more AssociationIds values are provided in the request, or if filters are used in the request.

subcommands.name: describe-data-repository-tasks
subcommands.description: Returns the description of specific Amazon FSx for Lustre or Amazon File Cache data repository tasks, if one or more TaskIds values are provided in the request, or if filters are used in the request.

subcommands.name: describe-file-caches
subcommands.description: Returns the description of a specific Amazon File Cache resource, if a FileCacheIds value is provided for that cache.

subcommands.name: describe-file-system-aliases
subcommands.description: Returns the DNS aliases that are associated with the specified Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system.

subcommands.name: describe-file-systems
subcommands.description: Returns the description of specific Amazon FSx file systems, if a FileSystemIds value is provided for that file system.

subcommands.name: describe-s3-access-point-attachments
subcommands.description: Describes one or more S3 access points attached to Amazon FSx volumes.

subcommands.name: describe-shared-vpc-configuration
subcommands.description: Indicates whether participant accounts in your organization can create Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP Multi-AZ file systems in subnets that are shared by a virtual private cloud (VPC) owner.

subcommands.name: describe-snapshots
subcommands.description: Returns the description of specific Amazon FSx for OpenZFS snapshots, if a SnapshotIds value is provided.

subcommands.name: describe-storage-virtual-machines
subcommands.description: Describes one or more Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP storage virtual machines (SVMs).

subcommands.name: describe-volumes
subcommands.description: Describes one or more Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP or Amazon FSx for OpenZFS volumes.

subcommands.name: detach-and-delete-s3-access-point
subcommands.description: Detaches an S3 access point from an Amazon FSx volume and deletes the S3 access point.

subcommands.name: disassociate-file-system-aliases
subcommands.description: Use this action to disassociate, or remove, one or more Domain Name Service (DNS) aliases from an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists tags for Amazon FSx resources.

subcommands.name: release-file-system-nfs-v3-locks
subcommands.description: Releases the file system lock from an Amazon FSx for OpenZFS file system.

subcommands.name: restore-volume-from-snapshot
subcommands.description: Returns an Amazon FSx for OpenZFS volume to the state saved by the specified snapshot.

subcommands.name: start-misconfigured-state-recovery
subcommands.description: After performing steps to repair the Active Directory configuration of an FSx for Windows File Server file system, use this action to initiate the process of Amazon FSx attempting to reconnect to the file system.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Tags an Amazon FSx resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: This action removes a tag from an Amazon FSx resource.

subcommands.name: update-data-repository-association
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration of an existing data repository association on an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system.

subcommands.name: update-file-cache
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration of an existing Amazon File Cache resource.

subcommands.name: update-file-system
subcommands.description: Use this operation to update the configuration of an existing Amazon FSx file system.

subcommands.name: update-shared-vpc-configuration
subcommands.description: Configures whether participant accounts in your organization can create Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP Multi-AZ file systems in subnets that are shared by a virtual private cloud (VPC) owner.

subcommands.name: update-snapshot
subcommands.description: Updates the name of an Amazon FSx for OpenZFS snapshot.

subcommands.name: update-storage-virtual-machine
subcommands.description: Updates an FSx for ONTAP storage virtual machine (SVM).

subcommands.name: update-volume
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration of an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP or Amazon FSx for OpenZFS volume.
